authority: Cambridge IGCSE Geography 0460 syllabus for 2025 and 2026: section 3 Subject content, themes 1 to 3 (pages 13 to 21); section 4 Details of the assessment, the Paper 2 geographical skills (pages 21 and 23 to 26) and the Paper 4 enquiry skills (pages 31 to 33).
granularity_note: One objective per learning outcome ("Candidates should be able to") and one per case study the syllabus requires ("Case Studies required for"). Each syllabus topic (1.1 to 3.7) is a container, with two content units: its outcomes (x.y.1) and its case studies (x.y.2). The further-guidance column is carried on each outcome as syllabus_guidance: the syllabus prints it for the topic as a whole, and where it says "including", the listed items are required content. Topic 4 holds the Paper 2 geographical skills (4.1 mapwork, 4.2 maps, graphs, tables and written material, 4.3 photographs, 4.4 mathematical skills) and topic 5 the Paper 4 enquiry skills (5.1 hypotheses to 5.5 conclusions and evaluation).
papers_note: Themes 1-3 are assessed on Paper 1 and also supply the knowledge Papers 2 and 4 ask about (AO1); topic 4 is assessed on Paper 2 and topic 5 on Paper 4, Alternative to Coursework. Each objective carries the paper that assesses it as its main demand.
